## R Markdown


On lit les données dans le tableau `df` de la manière suivante

```{r}
df = read.csv2("/user/0/beggarr/equipe_15/ONISR-2019.csv",sep=",")
View(df)
head(df)
str(df)
```

## Including Plots

You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r}
df$S_sevérité <- (9*df$nb_tue+3*df$nb_hospitalise+df$nb_blesse)/13*100
max(df$nb_blesse)
max(df$nb_hospitalise)
max(df$nb_tue)
max(df$S_sevérité)
```

Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.
```{r}
View(df)
head(df)
```
